event_chain.summary: Records obtained through HIE requests with unverified purpose

summary: Trinity Health learned on January 13, 2026 from its health information exchange partner that companies obtaining records through Health Gorilla, an HIE member, had requested patient data claiming a treatment purpose that could not be verified. Clinical, demographic and insurance information and possibly driver's license numbers of 2,740 Trinity Health patients were involved.
